name: ProGroCo Live Rosin Disposable | Purple Push Pop
description:
Breeder: Archive Seed Bank 

Lineage: Zkittlez x Do-Si-Dos 

Terpenes: Caryophyllene, D-Limonene, ß-Myrcene 

Aroma: Pepper, Sweet, Earthy 

Effects: Relaxed, Focused, Creative, Social 

Our Award-Winning Moonbow #112 is a fragrant hybrid that sends consumers over the stars with its delightful fruity aroma and sweet candy taste. Bred by Archive Seed Bank, Moonbow is a cross of Zkittlez and Do-Si-Dos. The result combines the flavorful euphoria of Zkittles with the physical relaxation of Do-Si-Dos for a focused, creative, and social effect - Get ready for lift-off.
